entries.note: First real probation instance (epic #3383). `build`-kind delivery already had real trials before this date; `fix`/`ci-heal` delivery and the advisory-review seat do not yet — probation exists to collect that data without letting the seat gate anything. Promotion to `trusted` (or demotion to `unvalidated`) is a future ruling, not automatic — see #3651 (arm the run-quality router once a rubricVersion population exists).

The fifth review-panel seat (`judgeAntigravityReview`, `review-pr.mjs`), wired the same day the standalone `antigravity-judge-spawn.mjs` primitive first proved live against the real `agy` CLI (commit 63102bde8). Unlike codex's entry above, this identity has ZERO real trials in ANY role before this date — no prior delivery exercise to lean on — so it starts on `probation` with a more cautious posture, not a graduated one: no `delivery` role is declared at all (there is no Antigravity delivery agent; `antigravity-judge-spawn.mjs`'s own header explains why a write-capable seat is not safe yet — `--sandbox` only confines its shell, not its 57 in-process tools). Promotion to `trusted` (or demotion to `unvalidated`) is a future ruling, not automatic — see #3651.
